findings: Owner SWE.4: workproducts/SWE.4/unit_verification_report.md omits the manifest scope exclusions for reset generation, interrupt handler, RCC clock enable, hardware watchdog option, debug freeze, disable and deinitialisation; document these exclusions in the verification scope

Owner SWE.4: software/tests/unit/test_wwdg.cpp UT-007 tests preservation of EWI only from initial state 1 although SWR-029 requires both initial states. UT-008 checks repeated call counts and two ordering relationships but does not assert repeated prescaler/window/counter arguments or the complete initialisation sequence required by USPEC-HAL-01-08

Owner SWE.4: unit_verification_report.md Static analysis lists tool results and a subset disclaimer without review or disposition of manual coding-rule gaps. verification/static/misra_coverage_matrix.md leaves unsupported rules requiring manual review, and workproducts/SWE.3/misra_deviations.md records no review or deviations

Owner SWE.4: matrix_4_unittest_to_unitspec.csv marks USPEC-HAL-01-09, USPEC-HAL-02-04 and USPEC-HAL-04-03 VERIFIED although UT-009/014/021 assert only LL calls. The report explicitly states register preservation is not established, but the traceability records contain no qualification or linked closure evidence for these outstanding obligations
